narrative.intro: Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk recorded $519M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk has shown variable annual obligations over the last six fiscal years: FY21 $355M, FY22 $299M, FY23 $523M, FY24 $148M, FY25 $296M, and FY26 $519M. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk’s current-year total is a partial fiscal-year figure. Bae Systems Maritime Solutions Norfolk’s recent activity includes larger awards on average, reflected in the $51.9M average award size, and the year-over-year rise in obligations of up 75.5%.
